Home Fibre vs Home WiFi:

Which home Internet plan is best for you in Malaysia?

Home Fibre

CelcomDigi Home Fibre delivers high-speed Internet through dedicated fibre optic cables, ensuring a stable broadband connection. It’s built for heavy use, low latency gaming, streaming, and large households, all with the convenience of unlimited plans.

Speed: Consistently fast, up to 1Gbps+

Stability: Very stable, low latency, not affected by weather

Setup: Needs professional installation

Best for:  Heavy users, 4K streaming, gaming, large households

Home Wifi

CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi connects through the 5G mobile network to provide wireless broadband for your home. It’s wireless, easy to set up, and perfect for those who need a quick, flexible Internet solution or for areas without fibre.

Speed: Decent speeds, depends on 4G/5G coverage

Stability: Reliable within mobile coverage

Setup: Plug-and-play, no setup needed

Best for: Light/moderate users, small homes, renters, temporary setups

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi and using my mobile hotspot data?

CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi delivers a more stable, high-speed home Internet experience with unlimited data, designed to support multiple devices at once. It comes with a dedicated WiFi 7 router that uses AI-powered optimisation to intelligently manage your connection, ensuring smoother streaming, gaming, and work-from-home use across your home.

Mobile hotspots rely on your phone’s data and battery, which can result in slower speeds, interruptions, and quicker battery drain, especially when multiple devices are connected. For a more reliable and consistent home Internet setup, CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi is the better choice.

Is CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi reliable for gaming, streaming, and work-from-home setups?

Yes. CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi is built to support gaming, streaming, and work-from-home needs. With a next-generation WiFi 7 router and AI-powered network optimisation, your connection is intelligently prioritised based on usage — helping reduce lag during gaming, improve streaming quality, and keep video calls stable, even with multiple devices connected.

Reliability may vary depending on your area’s 5G/4G coverage and network conditions.

How do I activate my free 24-month Viu Premium subscription?

Your Viu Premium subscription is automatically activated when you sign up for a CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi plan.

For your first login, open the Viu app or visit the Viu website and enter your CelcomDigi 5G Home WiFi number to access your premium content.
